source.en: Click the Guardian to interact with it.

source.ch: 我宗一举击溃了{1}并取走了其宗门内的全部资源，共计斩获{3}灵石、{4}药材、{5}矿材，作为交换，我宗留其香火存续，并未将其抹灭。战后，宗主论功行赏，消耗{6}灵石、{7}药材、{8}矿材给参战弟子发放了奖励。

source.en: Our Sect defeated {1} and took all the resources of the Sect, which amounted to a total of {3} Spirit Stones, {4} Herbs, and {5} Ores. In exchange, our Sect has kept their incense burning, and did not wipe them out. After the battle, the Sect Leader rewarded the Sect Disciples for their contributions, using {6} Spirit Stones, {7} Herbs, and {8} Ores.
